packageRules.description: Rust crates: automerge anything that is not a major bump. The gate pins the toolchain and clippy denies warnings, so a bad bump fails CI before it can merge.
Rust major bumps need a human: they can change lint behaviour or the MSRV.
Workflow actions are exercised by every PR, so even a major is safe to automerge.
The Rust toolchain is pinned deliberately in rust-toolchain.toml; never move it automatically.
